supplements.title: Assessment and Management of Cancer-Related Cognitive Impairment.
supplements.summary: Cancer survivors commonly experience cognitive impairment affecting memory and attention, managed through neuropsychological testing, brain training, rehabilitation, and lifestyle modifications.

supplements.title: Nuclear Factor Erythroid 2-Related Factor 2-Dependent Ferroptosis Suppression by Salvianolic Acid B Preserves Microvascular Integrity and Reduces Risk Factors for Hemorrhagic Transformation After Cerebral Infarction.
supplements.summary: Salvianolic acid B protects the brain after stroke by blocking ferroptosis through the Nrf2 pathway, reducing brain damage.

supplements.title: Therapeutic potential of Lactobacillus kefiranofaciens ZW18 postbiotic in alleviating hepatocellular carcinoma.
supplements.summary: A bacterial supplement called Post18 slows hepatocellular carcinoma growth by boosting immune cells and beneficial gut bacteria in mice.

supplements.title: The anti-leukemic effects of vitamin K4 by modulating the JAK/STAT signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Vitamin K4 slows leukemia cell growth by blocking a key cellular signaling pathway involved in cancer development.

supplements.title: Oat-β-glucan potentiates anti-PD-1 efficacy through Faecalibacterium prausnitzii-derived butyrate and indole-3-propionic acid.
supplements.summary: Oat-β-glucan enhances anti-PD-1 immunotherapy for colorectal cancer by boosting beneficial gut bacteria that produce immune-activating compounds.

supplements.title: Integrating coconut processing residues into sustainable food systems: technological pathways towards a circular bioeconomy.
supplements.summary: Coconut processing waste can be converted into valuable products like biofuels, construction materials, and cosmetics through circular economy technologies.

supplements.title: Synergistic modification of phycocyanin by Lactobacillus plantarum and protease: Physicochemical properties, structural characteristics, and flavor profiles.
supplements.summary: Researchers enhanced phycocyanin's antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects through fermentation and enzyme treatment, improving its stability and taste for food use.

supplements.title: Soy-isoflavone to remedy induced or post-gamma-irradiation periodontitis in rat model.
supplements.summary: Soy isoflavones may protect teeth and bone from damage caused by cancer radiation therapy in rats.

supplements.title: A continuous DNA repairing system for alleviating intervertebral disc degeneration.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed a treatment system using nanozymes and stem cell vesicles that repairs DNA damage to reverse intervertebral disc degeneration in rats.

supplements.title: The reinforcing effect of anti-caries treatments on acidic challenge resistance of irradiated enamel.
supplements.summary: Anti-caries treatments like nanohydroxyapatite and resin infiltration strengthen irradiated tooth enamel against acid damage.

supplements.title: Spirulina, a dietary supplement, attenuates streptozotocin-induced diabetes by improving cognitive function through anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects in rats.
supplements.summary: Spirulina supplement improved memory and learning in diabetic rats by reducing inflammation and oxidative stress.

supplements.title: The effect of moderate physical activity on NK cells populations and cytotoxic T lymphocytes in young, healthy women.
supplements.summary: Moderate physical activity boosts cancer-fighting immune cells in young women, strengthening the body's natural defense against disease.

supplements.title: Neuroprotective Potential of Pinostrobin in a Rat Model of Huntington's Disease: Behavioural, Biochemical, and Molecular Docking Evidence.
supplements.summary: Pinostrobin, a natural compound, protected rats from Huntington's-like brain damage by reducing inflammation and oxidative stress.

supplements.title: Bioactivity-guided metabolomics reveals discriminant cytotoxic signatures in Siparuna guianensis.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified toxic compounds in a plant species that could lead to safer, more selective cancer treatments.

supplements.title: Cholesterol as a metabolic integrator of oncogenic signaling, immune evasion, and therapy resistance.
supplements.summary: Cholesterol fuels tumor growth and immune evasion; targeting cholesterol metabolism may restore cancer treatment sensitivity.

off_label.title: Polypharmacy, polypharmacology, and polypharmacotherapy: clarifying definitions and complementary roles in cancer treatment - a narrative review.
off_label.summary: While targeted cancer drugs work well for specific cancers, they have limited overall success; combining multiple drugs may offer better treatment strategies.

off_label.title: Midodrine to facilitate cardioprotective therapy in hypotensive HER2-positive breast cancer patients with cancer-therapy-related cardiac dysfunction-multicenter case experience.
off_label.summary: Midodrine helps HER2-positive breast cancer patients tolerate heart-protective medications by raising blood pressure during cancer treatment.

off_label.title: Cyclosporine in hematological disorders: mechanisms, clinical practice and emerging advances.
off_label.summary: Cyclosporine effectively treats blood disorders like aplastic anemia and myelodysplastic neoplasms by suppressing harmful T cell activation.

off_label.title: Pirfenidone Inhibits Inflammatory Mediators in Human Cornea In Vitro.
off_label.summary: Pirfenidone, an FDA-approved drug, reduces inflammation in human cornea cells in laboratory tests.

off_label.title: Alcohol-Induced Metabolic Stress Sensed by m6A-Modified ChREBP Drives Immune Evasion in Esophageal Carcinogenesis.
off_label.summary: Alcohol-induced changes to a protein called ChREBP help esophageal cancer cells evade the immune system, and blocking this process could prevent or treat the disease.

off_label.title: A STAT1/ETC/GBP1 axis represents a potential therapeutic target for noncommunicable granulomatous skin disease.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified that blocking a metabolic pathway and protein called GBP1 can reduce granuloma formation in skin diseases, suggesting metformin as a potential treatment.

off_label.title: EZH2 inhibition via GSK-126 mitigates EndMT and atherosclerosis in diabetes: A translational epigenetic approach.
off_label.summary: GSK-126 drug blocks EZH2 protein to reduce atherosclerosis and vessel damage in diabetic patients.

off_label.title: The Use of Ketamine for Depression in Cancer Patients: A Systematic Review of Efficacy, Safety, and Clinical Applications.
off_label.summary: Ketamine rapidly relieves depression in cancer patients within hours to days, offering a promising alternative to traditional antidepressants.

off_label.title: Cholesterol as a metabolic integrator of oncogenic signaling, immune evasion, and therapy resistance.
off_label.summary: Cholesterol fuels tumor growth and immune evasion; targeting cholesterol metabolism may restore cancer treatment sensitivity.

off_label.title: Metformin versus DPP-4 inhibitors and risk of parkinsonism in type 2 diabetes: an active-comparator cohort study with a landmark design.
off_label.summary: Metformin use in type 2 diabetes patients may reduce Parkinson's disease risk compared to DPP-4 inhibitors.

off_label.title: Effects of metformin on head and neck cancer: an umbrella review.
off_label.summary: Metformin's effectiveness against head and neck cancer remains unclear despite showing promise in other cancer types.

off_label.title: Causal relationship between aspirin use and age-related macular degeneration.
off_label.summary: Aspirin use may genetically increase the risk of age-related macular degeneration, a common eye disease affecting older adults.

off_label.title: Ferroptosis vulnerability of enzalutamide resistant prostate cancer conferred by ACSL4 overexpression and GPX4 antagonism.
off_label.summary: Enzalutamide-resistant prostate cancer becomes vulnerable to ferroptosis when GPX4 is blocked, offering a new treatment approach using the drug Auranofin.

off_label.title: A prototype-augmented graph representation learning framework for identifying brain disorder-associated genes and facilitating drug repurposing.
off_label.summary: A new AI method identifies genes linked to brain disorders like Parkinson's disease and discovers potential drug treatments.

off_label.title: Statins and risk of cardiovascular disease: Emulating a primary prevention trial in breast cancer survivors.
off_label.summary: Study evaluates whether statins reduce heart disease risk in breast cancer survivors using real-world patient data.

biomarkers.title: TET2-CHIP: From Mutation to Malady.
biomarkers.summary: TET2 mutations in blood cells increase heart disease and inflammation risk through clonal expansion, offering potential new treatment targets.

biomarkers.title: Insulin Producing Cells Specific dilp2 Knockdown Induced T1D Model Reveals Circadian and Oxidative Stress Associated DEPs.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers created a fruit fly type 1 diabetes model showing that insulin knockdown alone causes metabolic disease, circadian disruption, and oxidative stress without severe side effects.

biomarkers.title: Different Functions of Mitofusin in Influencing the Migration and Invasion of BT20 via Regulating Metabolism and EMT.
biomarkers.summary: Reducing the MFN1 protein increases triple-negative breast cancer cell migration and invasion by boosting glycolysis and mitochondrial division.

biomarkers.title: CAMK1 Suppresses Anoikis Resistance and Liver Metastasis in Colorectal Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: CAMK1 suppresses colorectal cancer metastasis by inhibiting the PI3K/AKT pathway, making cancer cells more susceptible to death.

biomarkers.title: Mitochondrial-Haplotype Influences Plasma Metabolome, Lipidome, and Proteome in a Sex Specific Manner in the Genetically Heterogenous OKC-HETB /W Rat.
biomarkers.summary: Mitochondrial DNA variants influence aging-related changes in metabolism and proteins differently in males versus females.

biomarkers.title: Targeting DNMT1 Attenuates Radiation-Induced Heart Disease: An Integrated Multiomic and Functional Study.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking DNMT1 protein reduces heart damage caused by cancer radiation therapy by restoring protective cellular signaling pathways.

biomarkers.title: Deletion of Plasmodium yoelii Merozoite Surface Protein 8 Protects Mice From Lethal Blood-Stage Malaria and Is Associated With Enhanced Splenic CCL19-CCR7 Signaling.
biomarkers.summary: Removing a malaria parasite protein (MSP8) protects mice from lethal infection by boosting immune signaling in the spleen.

biomarkers.title: Mts/PP2AC Induces Cell Migration via Rho1-Slpr-Mediated JNK Pathway.
biomarkers.summary: PP2AC protein promotes pancreatic cancer cell migration by activating a Rho1-JNK signaling pathway, suggesting a potential drug target.

biomarkers.title: Intravesical Delivery of P21 mRNA-Loaded Lipid Nanoparticles as a Tumor Suppressor Replacement Therapy for Bladder Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a bladder cancer treatment using particles containing p21 mRNA, delivered directly to the bladder, which successfully reduced tumor growth in mice.

biomarkers.title: Structural and Functional Basis of SSTR5 Homodimerization in Controlling Receptor Signaling and Pasireotide Response in Corticotroph Adenomas.
biomarkers.summary: SSTR5 receptor dimers in pituitary tumors reduce drug effectiveness, suggesting dimer status could predict treatment response to pasireotide.

biomarkers.title: Development of Immunoelectron Microscopy for VASN Detection Using Multiple Models and Identification of VASN as a Key Regulator of Mitochondrial Homeostasis in Hepatocellular Carcinoma Cells.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified VASN protein in liver cancer cell mitochondria, showing it regulates mitochondrial health and cancer cell growth.

trials.title: Breaking the Immune Sanctuary: Targeting Metastatic Niches.

trials.title: Neurologic immune-related adverse events from immune checkpoint inhibitors: recent advances and future prospectives.
trials.summary: Immune checkpoint inhibitors can cause serious neurological side effects requiring rapid diagnosis and treatment to prevent severe outcomes.

trials.title: The climber's finger: imaging of non-pulley finger injuries.
trials.summary: This article reviews imaging methods for diagnosing non-pulley finger injuries in climbers to enable early intervention and prevent long-term complications.

trials.title: Primary adrenal insufficiency induced by immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs): a case series and systematic literature review.
trials.summary: Immunotherapy can cause rare but serious adrenal gland failure in cancer patients, requiring close monitoring by oncologists and endocrinologists.

trials.title: Apatinib enhances anti-PD-1 efficacy by inhibiting Exo70-mediated exosome secretion in pMMR/MSS colorectal cancer.
trials.summary: Apatinib combined with immunotherapy improves outcomes for hard-to-treat colorectal cancer by reducing tumor exosomes that block immune response.

trials.title: Cardio-Obstetrics Care: Challenging Scenarios in Heart Failure and Future Directions.
trials.summary: Dedicated cardio-obstetric care improves outcomes for pregnant women with heart disease or heart failure risk.

trials.title: Effect of integrated nursing on serum inflammatory factors and oxygenation indices in children with severe respiratory failure: A prospective quasi-experimental controlled study.
trials.summary: Integrated nursing care reduces inflammation and improves breathing outcomes in critically ill children with severe respiratory failure.

trials.title: Bioconjugates for breast cancer theranostics: improving target selectivity and treatment efficacy.
trials.summary: Bioconjugates improve breast cancer diagnosis and treatment by better targeting cancer cells while reducing side effects.

trials.title: Improving salvage regimens prior to autologous stem cell transplantation in relapsed/refractory Hodgkin's lymphoma patients: updates in the novel therapy era.
trials.summary: Novel drugs like brentuximab vedotin and immunotherapy improve survival outcomes for relapsed Hodgkin's lymphoma patients undergoing stem cell transplants.

trials.title: Midodrine to facilitate cardioprotective therapy in hypotensive HER2-positive breast cancer patients with cancer-therapy-related cardiac dysfunction-multicenter case experience.
trials.summary: Midodrine helps HER2-positive breast cancer patients tolerate heart-protective medications by raising blood pressure during cancer treatment.

trials.title: HyperSightTM-CBCT based monitoring of sarcopenia during definitive radiotherapy of prostate cancer: a longitudinal feasibility study.
trials.summary: HyperSight™ imaging successfully tracks muscle loss during prostate cancer radiation therapy, potentially identifying patients at risk for treatment complications.

trials.title: Early radiological response pattern predicts long-term response in patients with non-small cell lung cancer treated with immune-checkpoint inhibitors.
trials.summary: Early imaging changes predict which lung cancer patients will benefit long-term from immunotherapy treatment.

trials.title: Tunable PEGylation platform for efficient siRNA delivery using mesoporous silica nanoparticles.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a simplified coating method for nanoparticles that improves gene therapy delivery and silencing of cancer-related PD-L1 protein.

trials.title: Atezolizumab versus pembrolizumab in the treatment of advanced triple-negative breast cancer: a Bayesian network meta-analysis of ITT and PD-L1 positive populations.
trials.summary: Atezolizumab and pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy show comparable effectiveness for treating advanced triple-negative breast cancer.

trials.title: Extreme hyperleukocytosis and blueberry muffin skin lesions as the initial presentation of neonatal leukemia: a case report.
trials.summary: Neonatal leukemia presented with dangerous blood cell overgrowth and skin lesions, highlighting urgent need for immediate treatment in newborns.
